files..bubble-tracks/abilities/risks.md:
---
name: risks
description: List what could go wrong with the active bubble, then report
type: bubble
---
Workflow:
1. Restate the active bubble in one sentence.
2. List three things that could go wrong when building it.
3. Report back in a few lines and stop. Don't start building the bubble.
